title: Spicy Poblano Rajas with Jalapeno Cream Sauce
description: A flavorful and spicy Mexican dish made with roasted poblanos, jalapeno cream sauce, and a hint of spice.
instructions: Roast the dried poblanos in the oven for 15-20 minutes, turning occasionally, until charred and blistered.
Remove the poblanos from the oven and let them cool in a bowl, covered with plastic wrap.
Once the poblanos have cooled, peel off the skin and chop them into 1-inch pieces.
In a blender or food processor, puree the roasted poblanos, jalapeno, crema, and Mexican spiced until smooth.
Heat the poblano cream sauce over medium heat until hot and bubbly.
Season the sauce with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the spicy poblano rajas with the jalapeno cream sauce spooned over the top.
